definitions.clean_seeds: All 250 submitted rows cut; HDR band is a subset.
definitions.band_seeds: All 250 submitted rows return HDR, scanned over every seed 100-999.
definitions.cas12a_clean_seeds: All submitted Cas12a rows cut over 100-999 (100 rows for conjunction; 74 for h1's fallback).
definitions.clean_seeds_in_joined_space: Full-row clean seeds inside the 300-seed joined band space.
definitions.clean_seeds_outside_joined_space: Full-row clean seeds outside the band space, within the 900-seed cut search space.
definitions.candidate_window: Planned 150-seed slice reconstructed from logged joined space and offsets 0/50/100/150/200/250/25. h1 submitted an ordinary fallback instead.
